title: Senior Full Stack Developer(West Bengal Candidates apply only)
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer(West Bengal Candidates apply only)

**Company:** Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Kolkata, West Bengal  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Job Overview

Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in developing, maintaining, and optimizing web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in **Node.js and React.js** and be comfortable working across both frontend and backend development.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain scalable web applications using **Node.js and React.js**.
* Build responsive and user\-friendly frontend interfaces using React.js.
* Develop robust backend applications, APIs, and server\-side functionality using Node.js.
* Integrate RESTful APIs and third\-party services.
* Work with databases and perform database design, queries, and optimization.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, developers, QA teams, and project managers.
* Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and efficient code.
* Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
* Understand project requirements and deliver features within deadlines.
* Maintain technical documentation and development standards.

Required Skills

* 2–3 years of professional experience in **Full Stack Web Development**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Node.js and React.js**.
* Good knowledge of JavaScript / ES6\+.
* Experience in developing and consuming **REST APIs**.
* Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.
* Experience with databases such as **MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL**.
* Knowledge of Git/GitHub or other version\-control systems.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

title: T&T - OIDS - Full Stack & Digital Transformation - Senior Consultant - Kolkata
description:
**T\&T \- OIDS \- Full Stack \& Digital Transformation \- Senior Consultant \- Kolkata**
  

* **Job requisition ID** : 111825
* **Location**: Kolkata
* **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The Team**

  


Deloitte’s Technology \& Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact\-driven decision\-making and generate an insight\-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence \& visualization, data management, performance management and next\-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.  



  

  

**Your work profile**

  


Lead and manage **application development and digital transformation initiatives** for the Silpasathi State Single Window project, with a focus on web applications, API integrations, CMS platforms and Government digital services.

### 


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end development, enhancement and integration of the Silpasathi portal.
* Coordinate with Government stakeholders, System Integrators and development teams.
* Provide technical oversight for **Node.js, React.js and Drupal\-based applications**.
* Review FRS/SRS, technical architecture, APIs, workflows and development deliverables.
* Manage UAT, deployment, production support and issue resolution.
* Lead API/system integrations and onboarding of G2B/G2G services.
* Monitor project timelines, application performance, risks and deliverables.
* Prepare project status reports and presentations for senior stakeholders


### **Educational Qualification**


* B.E./B.Tech./MCA/M.Tech. in Computer Science, IT or related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM preferred.


### **Experience**


* **10\+ years** in software development, IT consulting or digital transformation.
* **6\+ years** in software/project leadership, preferably in Government/Public Sector.
* Strong experience in **Node.js, React.js, Drupal, REST APIs and web application development**.
* Experience managing development teams/System Integrators and technology projects.
* Government/eGovernance, Single Window and G2B/G2G experience preferred.
* Knowledge of Agile, DevOps, cloud, databases and application security is an advantage.

Node.js
  

React.js

REST APIs
  

Web Development

System Integration Agile
  

DevOps \| Project Management
